note: Stand-in for Telegraph's node-internal Stage-2 benchmark, which is not published. Modelled on the only example the docs give: prose Q/A, one known-good answer, one known-bad. 32 cases to match the 32/32 vs 19/32 figure in the docs' worked example. 'bad_kind' tags the failure mode so honest displacement measurement stays separable from exploit demonstration. Each case carries two distractors: `bad` (plausible-wrong near-miss, one wrong fact in the right phrasing) and `bad_unrelated` (another question's correct answer, mirroring the docs' Stage-1 cross-match). Measure the two regimes separately -- the champion behaves completely differently on each.
